profile:
# Truffle Shuffle

Truffle Shuffle is a recurring background Earth pony colt from *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*, associated with Cheerilee’s Ponyville school class. He has a rounded build, a gray coat, dark brown mane and tail, blue eyes, and a knife-and-fork cutie mark. The [character reference](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Truffle) also identifies him as Truffle and Teacher’s Pet.

- **Naming:** Truffle Shuffle is a widely used fan identification. Gameloft game documentation records both Teacher’s Pet and Truffle; the precise origin of the fan name and an on-screen use of the name have not been established.
- **Speaking status:** No individually attributed speaking role or voice actor was verified.
- **Appearances:** In *Ponyville Confidential* he reads the Foal Free Press while wearing a red fez and rectangular glasses. He also appears among the students in *Family Appreciation Day* and *Twilight Time*, and in the crowd in *Slice of Life*. The linked production screencaps document these appearances.

The featured image is a cropped production screencap from *Ponyville Confidential*, credited to the Hasbro/DHX Media television production. Character-wiki and game-wiki details were checked against indexed text; the character wiki itself could not be opened directly.
